025/**
026 * Abstract superclass representing a standard DayPlanner GUI panel (such as
027 * Add or Search) used inside a CardLayout.
028 */
029public abstract class GUIWindow extends JPanel {
030    /**
031     * Default dimensions of the GUI window.
032     */
033    public static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(800, 600);
034
035    /**
036     * Background color for the GUI window panel.
037     */
038    private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(250, 250, 250);
039
040    /**
041     * Padding border applied around panels in the window.
042     */
043    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
044
045    /**
046     * Reference to the activity list.
047     */
048    public ActivityList activities;
049
050    /**
051     * Combo box for selecting activity type ("home", "school", "other").
052     */
053    public JComboBox<String> typeComboBox;
054
055    /**
056     * List of JLabels in the center form panel.
057     */
058    public ArrayList<JLabel> centerLabels = new ArrayList<JLabel>();
059
060    /**
061     * ArrayList that contains all of the JTextField instances in the center panel.
062     */
063    public ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields = new ArrayList<JTextField>();
064
065    /**
066     * Message box text area.
067     */
068    public JTextArea messages = null;
069
070    /**
071     * Scroll pane containing the message box.
072     */
073    public JScrollPane scrollPane = null;
074
075    /**
076     * The reset button.
077     */
078    public JButton resetButton = null;
079
080    /**
081     * The primary action button (e.g. Add or Search).
082     */
083    public JButton actionButton = null;
084
085    /**
086     * Creates and initializes a new Swing GUI panel.
087     * 
088     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
089     */
090    public GUIWindow(ActivityList activities) {
091        super();
092        this.activities = activities;
093
094        setPreferredSize(DIMS);
095        setBackground(BACKGROUND);
096        setLayout(new BorderLayout(12, 12));
097        setBorder(PADDING);
098
099        add(createCenterPanel(), BorderLayout.CENTER);
100        add(createEastPanel(), BorderLayout.EAST);
101        add(createSouthPanel(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * Creates the center form panel containing input fields.
106     * 
107     * @return Initialized JPanel for center region.
108     */
109    public JPanel createCenterPanel() {
110        String[] labels = getFieldLabels();
111        int rows = labels.length + 2; // +2 for the header rows
112
113        JPanel centerPanel = new JPanel();
114        centerPanel.setLayout(new GridLayout(rows, 2, 8, 8));
115        centerPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
116        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getHeaderText()));
117        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
118        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getSubHeaderText()));
119        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
120
121        centerLabels.clear();
122        centerFields.clear();
123
124        for (int i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
125            String labelText = labels[i];
126            JLabel label = new JLabel(labelText);
127            centerLabels.add(label);
128            centerPanel.add(label);
129
130            if (i == 0) {
131                String[] options = getTypeOptions();
132                typeComboBox = new JComboBox<>(options);
133                if (options.length > 0) {
134                    typeComboBox.setSelectedItem(options[0]);
135                }
136                centerPanel.add(typeComboBox);
137            } else {
138                JTextField tf = new JTextField();
139                centerPanel.add(tf);
140                centerFields.add(tf);
141            }
142        }
143
144        return centerPanel;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Creates the east panel containing action buttons.
149     * 
150     * @return Initialized JPanel for east region.
151     */
152    public JPanel createEastPanel() {
153        JPanel eastPanel = new JPanel();
154        eastPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
155        eastPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(eastPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
156
157        ActionListener buttonEvent = new ActionListener() {
158            @Override
159            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
160                String action = event.getActionCommand();
161                if ("RESET".equals(action)) {
162                    resetFields();
163                } else if (getActionButtonCommand().equals(action)) {
164                    executeAction();
165                }
166            }
167        };
168
169        resetButton = new JButton("Reset");
170        resetButton.setActionCommand("RESET");
171        resetButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
172        eastPanel.add(resetButton);
173
174        actionButton = new JButton(getActionButtonLabel());
175        actionButton.setActionCommand(getActionButtonCommand());
176        actionButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
177        eastPanel.add(actionButton);
178
179        return eastPanel;
180    }
181
182    /**
183     * Creates the south panel containing the message log display.
184     * 
185     * @return Initialized JPanel for south region.
186     */
187    public JPanel createSouthPanel() {
188        JPanel southPanel = new JPanel();
189        southPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(southPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
190        southPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
191
192        JLabel messageLabel = new JLabel("<html><b>" + getMessageBoxLabel() + "</b></html>");
193        messageLabel.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
194        southPanel.add(messageLabel);
195        southPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
196
197        messages = new JTextArea(5, 40);
198        messages.setEditable(false);
199        messages.setLineWrap(false);
200        messages.setWrapStyleWord(false);
201        messages.setBackground(Color.WHITE);
202
203        scrollPane = new JScrollPane(messages);
204        scrollPane.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
205        scrollPane.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
206        scrollPane.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(760, 100));
207        scrollPane.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 110));
208        scrollPane.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
209        southPanel.add(scrollPane);
210
211        return southPanel;
212    }
213
214    /**
215     * Resets all text input fields in the center panel without resetting the combo box.
216     */
217    public void resetFields() {
218        if (centerFields != null) {
219            for (JTextField tf : centerFields) {
220                tf.setText(null);
221            }
222        }
223    }
224
225    /**
226     * Returns the options for the activity type combo box.
227     * 
228     * @return Array of type option strings, defaulting to "home", "school", and "other".
229     */
230    protected String[] getTypeOptions() {
231        return new String[]{"home", "school", "other"};
232    }
233
234    /**
235     * Clears all messages from the message box.
236     */
237    public void clearMessages() {
238        if (messages != null) {
239            messages.setText("");
240        }
241    }
242
243    /**
244     * Add a message to the top of the message box and scroll to the top.
245     * Does nothing if the text box hasn't been initialized yet or if the text is blank.
246     * 
247     * @param text Text to add.
248     */
249    public void addMessage(String text) {
250        if (messages == null || text == null || text.isBlank())
251            return;
252
253        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
254        sb.append("> ");
255        sb.append(text);
256        if (!messages.getText().isEmpty()) {
257            sb.append("\n");
258            sb.append(messages.getText());
259        }
260
261        messages.setText(sb.toString());
262        messages.setCaretPosition(0);
263        if (scrollPane != null) {
264            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
265                scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
266            });
267        }
268    }
269
270    /**
271     * Appends a message to the end of the message box and scrolls to the top.
272     * Does nothing if the text box hasn't been initialized yet or if the text is blank.
273     * 
274     * @param text Text to append.
275     */
276    public void appendMessage(String text) {
277        if (messages == null || text == null || text.isBlank())
278            return;
279
280        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
281        if (!messages.getText().isEmpty()) {
282            sb.append(messages.getText());
283            sb.append("\n");
284        }
285        sb.append("> ");
286        sb.append(text);
287
288        messages.setText(sb.toString());
289        messages.setCaretPosition(0);
290        if (scrollPane != null) {
291            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
292                scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
293            });
294        }
295    }
296
297    /**
298     * Validates and parses a required time string using
299     * {@link Input#parseTime(String)} and
300     * {@link Time#getValidationError(int, int, int, int, int)}.
301     * 
302     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
303     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
304     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid (with error
305     *         added to messages).
306     */
307    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName) {
308        return parseAndValidateTime(timeStr, fieldName, true);
309    }
310
311    /**
312     * Validates and parses a time string with optional requirement check.
313     * 
314     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
315     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
316     * @param required  Whether the field is required. If false and input is blank,
317     *                  returns null without error.
318     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid or empty.
319     */
320    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName, boolean required) {
321        if (timeStr == null || timeStr.isBlank()) {
322            if (required)
323                addMessage(fieldName + " cannot be empty. Expected format: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM.");
324            return null;
325        }
326
327        Time time = Input.parseTime(timeStr);
328        if (time != null)
329            return time;
330
331        String[] components = timeStr.trim().split("[/:,\\s]+");
332        if (components.length < 5) {
333            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + " format. Expected: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM (e.g. 2026/09/10 17:30).");
334            return null;
335        }
336
337        try {
338            int y = Integer.parseInt(components[0]);
339            int m = Integer.parseInt(components[1]);
340            int d = Integer.parseInt(components[2]);
341            int h = Integer.parseInt(components[3]);
342            int min = Integer.parseInt(components[4]);
343
344            return new Time(y, m, d, h, min);
345        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
346            addMessage(fieldName + " components must be integers.");
347        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
348            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + ": " + e.getMessage());
349        }
350
351        return null;
352    }
